quality_guards: Diving controls depend on the diving class, depth, breathing system, work task, environment, team competence, medical fitness and emergency arrangements.
Diving guidance is project-, diver-, equipment-, task- and condition-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury or fatality probability.
Offshore emergency controls depend on hydrocarbon inventory, ignition potential, detection coverage, containment, installation layout, weather, occupancy and evacuation resources.
Offshore PFEER evidence is installation-, scenario-, barrier- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level major-accident probability.
Pipeline integrity risk depends on fluid, pressure, route, material, age, corrosion, geotechnical loads, third-party activity, inspection quality and emergency arrangements.
MAH-pipeline evidence is asset-, fluid-, route-, condition- and lifecycle-specific and is not an exact parcel-level release or consequence probability.
Notification duties depend on whether the pipeline is MAH-classified, the lifecycle stage, the scale of change, the operator identity and the effect on risk.
Pipeline-notification evidence is project-, operator-, modification- and lifecycle-specific and is not an exact parcel-level safety probability.
Gas-supply safety depends on network pressure, demand, supply availability, storage, isolation capability, safety-case controls, participant co-operation and emergency decisions.
Gas-safety-case evidence is network-, operator-, demand-, supply- and scenario-specific and is not an exact parcel-level outage or incident probability.
Offshore control-system risk depends on architecture, hazardous-area classification, sensors, logic, power supplies, communications, maintenance, proof testing and human response.
Offshore control-system evidence is installation-, function-, barrier-, equipment- and condition-specific and is not an exact parcel-level major-incident probability.
Offshore medical provision depends on workforce size, remoteness, hazards, shift patterns, evacuation time, medic competence, equipment and access to external care.
Offshore first-aid evidence is installation-, workforce-, hazard-, competence- and response-specific and is not an exact parcel-level health-outcome probability.
Laboratory-animal-allergen risk depends on species, allergen load, cage system, handling task, ventilation, cleaning, clothing controls and worker susceptibility.
Laboratory-animal-allergen evidence is facility-, species-, task-, exposure- and worker-specific and is not an exact parcel-level asthma probability.
Biological-agent risk depends on hazard group, agent, route, concentration, scale, containment, procedures, worker susceptibility and emergency capability.
Deliberate-biological-work evidence is agent-, process-, containment-, worker- and incident-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Gas-emergency risk depends on supply-demand balance, storage, network pressure, isolation capability, consumer priority, weather, communications and operator decisions.
Gas-emergency evidence is network-, season-, demand-, supply-, consumer- and scenario-specific and is not an exact parcel-level interruption probability.
Official-source context is not converted into an exact parcel-level probability.
